mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperuricemia and may compete for renal tubular secretion; chloroquine may inhibit hepatic metabolism of pyrazinamide, and both drugs carry hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels, liver function tests, and gout symptoms; ensure adequate hydration; consider allopurinol if hyperuricemia develops; avoid combination if possible, particularly in patients with gout or hepatic impairment.
